--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sZMod_eq_s (p' : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : sZMod (p' + 2) i = (s i : ZMod (2 ^ (p' + 2) - 1)) := by
  induction' i with i ih
  · dsimp [s, sZMod]
    norm_num
  · push_cast [s, sZMod, ih]; rfl

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sModNat_aux_eq (q k : ℕ) : sModNat_aux (4 % q) q k = sModNat q k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => rw [sModNat_aux, ih, sModNat, ← ih]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem order_ineq (p' : ℕ) (h : lucasLehmerResidue (p' + 2) = 0) :
    2 ^ (p' + 2) < (q (p' + 2) : ℕ) ^ 2 :=
  calc
    2 ^ (p' + 2) = orderOf (ωUnit (p' + 2)) := (order_ω p' h).symm
    _ ≤ Fintype.card (X (q (p' + 2)))ˣ := orderOf_le_card_univ
    _ < (q (p' + 2) : ℕ) ^ 2 := card_units_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt (two_lt_q _))

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Totient
theorem totient_even {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 < n) : Even n.totient := by
  haveI : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨one_lt_two.trans hn⟩
  haveI : NeZero n := NeZero.of_gt hn
  suffices 2 = orderOf (-1 : (ZMod n)ˣ) by
    rw [← ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, even_iff_two_dvd, this]
    exact orderOf_dvd_card
  rw [← orderOf_units, Units.coe_neg_one, orderOf_neg_one, ringChar.eq (ZMod n) n, if_neg hn.ne']

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LegendreSymbol.JacobiSymbol
/-- The symbol `J(0 | b)` vanishes when `b > 1`. -/
theorem zero_left {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) : J(0 | b) = 0 :=
  (@eq_zero_iff_not_coprime 0 b ⟨ne_zero_of_lt hb⟩).mpr <| by
    rw [Int.gcd_zero_left, Int.natAbs_ofNat]; exact hb.ne'

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sMod_lt (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (i : ℕ) : sMod p i < 2 ^ p - 1 := by
  rw [← sMod_mod]
  refine (Int.emod_lt _ (mersenne_int_ne_zero p hp)).trans_eq ?_
  exact abs_of_nonneg (mersenne_int_pos hp).le

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LegendreSymbol.ZModChar
/-- If `n % 4 = 1`, then `χ₄ n = 1`. -/
theorem χ₄_nat_one_mod_four {n : ℕ} (hn : n % 4 = 1) : χ₄ n = 1 := by
  rw [χ₄_nat_mod_four, hn]
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Defs
protected lemma pow_lt_pow_left (h : a < b) : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → a ^ n < b ^ n
  | 1, _ => by simpa
  | n + 2, _ => Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (Nat.pow_lt_pow_left h n.succ_ne_zero) (Nat.le_of_lt h)
    (zero_lt_of_lt h)

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem isNat_not_lucasLehmerTest : {p np : ℕ} →
    IsNat p np → ¬ LucasLehmerTest np → ¬ LucasLehmerTest p
  | _, _, ⟨rfl⟩, h => h

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Basic
/-- If `x ^ n = 1`, then `x ^ m` is the same as `x ^ (m % n)` -/
@[to_additive nsmul_eq_mod_nsmul "If `n • x = 0`, then `m • x` is the same as `(m % n) • x`"]
lemma pow_eq_pow_mod (m : ℕ) (ha : a ^ n = 1) : a ^ m = a ^ (m % n) := by
  calc
    a ^ m = a ^ (m % n + n * (m / n)) := by rw [Nat.mod_add_div]
    _ = a ^ (m % n) := by simp [pow_add, pow_mul, ha]

theorem sMod_nonneg (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ sMod p i := by
  cases i <;> dsimp [sMod]
  · exact sup_eq_right.mp rfl
  · apply Int.emod_nonneg
    exact mersenne_int_ne_zero p hp

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LegendreSymbol.JacobiSymbol
/-- If `b` is odd, then `J(-2 | b)` is given by `χ₈' b`. -/
theorem at_neg_two {b : ℕ} (hb : Odd b) : J(-2 | b) = χ₈' b :=
  value_at (-2) χ₈'.toMonoidHom (fun p pp => @legendreSym.at_neg_two p ⟨pp⟩) hb
